author: Shubha Priya
review_text:
LoveMeTwice is absolutely the best way to refresh wardrobes and perhaps even give away your own good clothes you are bored with! Save the planet - it’s begging for this to become a way of life now.

When  I first stepped into LoveMeTwice I wasn’t expecting much in terms of getting my size and quality or taste to my liking. Was I in for a surprise!  At a quarter of their origin prices too. I bought a stunning Zara silk dress (why would anyone give this away!) and several really terrific cotton tops and even khakis that fit way better than the pants I have. And accessories that were spot on! So very satisfying not to pay a bomb and come away thrilled.

I love the concept of giving good clothes new bodies instead of trashing it in land fills - considering the enormous expense, labour and resources every piece of clothing takes to produce.

review_text:
Very disappointing and unprofessional behavior at this branch.
When a billing issue was raised immediately after payment, instead of resolving it responsibly, the response from the billing counter was dismissive and arrogant. I was told, “This is not Myntra,” when I mentioned that even online platforms process refunds and returns after several days — whereas this issue was reported within minutes and was clearly due to store error.
That tone and attitude do not suit a retail billing counter. A customer pointing out a mistake should not be met with defensiveness or sarcasm. Policies cannot be used as a shield to avoid correcting errors made by the store itself.
The bigger concern is the mindset — it feels more about protecting revenue than respecting customers. This branch seriously needs training in accountability and customer handling.
Based on the overall experience and similar feedback visible here, I would strongly advise others to double-check their bills and be cautious.
